text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan, I'm sorry.
Can I... lean on your shoulder? Just quietly.

When I saw North Flight pulling back while leaning on Yukino Bijin's shoulder,
all the color instantly drained from my face, but...
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're not hurt?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's true!
Teacher said so too, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: It's just that I seem to have pushed past my limits... I'm sorry for making you worry.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...I lost.
Those girls running the Tiara route truly are amazing.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even so...
I'm so glad I got to run today!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I figured out the secret behind
the brilliance of the Tiara route girls."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
They are dressed in classic, royal-road coordinates.
Their cuteness is the very radiance of a tiara.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I want to wear an outfit like that too...
One that makes my heart flutter!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"By the time the Shuka Sho comes,
I'm sure I'll be able to give it even more of my all."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "How will someone like me be able to shine...? I can't wait to find out!"

And so, North Flight's passion for the Shuka Sho
grew by yet another notch.
